title: Begin within Hukam
summary: Everything stands inside Hukam, not outside it. Return to Hukam before the self starts arguing again.
takeaway: Return to Hukam before the self starts arguing again.
lifeApplication: Before arguing with the moment again, stop, name what is already here, and let one resistance fall away.

source.shortMeaning: Everything stands inside Hukam, not outside it.
source.lifeApplication: Release the demand that peace must wait for total control.

evidence.coreClaim: Everything stands inside Hukam, not outside it.
evidence.turn: Everything stands within Hukam, and ego thins when this is seen.
evidence.practicalImplication: Before arguing with the moment again, stop, name what is already here, and let one resistance fall away.
